_comment: Conceptual hooks for Codex environments that support hooks. If the active Codex hook schema differs, activate these commands manually or adapt the event names below.

hooks.purpose: Load compact DocOps context when .docops exists.
hooks.command:
test -f .docops/s.md && { printf 'DOCOPS
'; cat .docops/s.md; printf '
RULES
'; cat .docops/c.yaml; printf '
KB_TAIL
'; tail -20 .docops/k.jsonl; } || true

hooks.purpose: Capture compact command or file-change summaries into .docops/ev.jsonl when the host exposes hook variables.
hooks.command: test -d .docops && python3 codex-docops-logic/scripts/dol.py ev add --ty cmd --cmd '${CODEX_TOOL_COMMAND:-tool}' --summary '${CODEX_TOOL_SUMMARY:-post_tool_use}' || true

hooks.purpose: Run soft deterministic reminders before handoff.
